datasets.name: Main
datasets.sql:
select rownum as c, f.name,b.name as borcalan,l.acc_no,p.numberofcredit,v.val_name,CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:sysdat)as pay,
CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:sysdat)*t.ostat as payek,
case when CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:sysdat)>0 then p.annualyinterestrate||' %'  else '0' end  as reate,
CM_RPORT.get_Tranches(p.id,:sysdat) as kred_meb,
CM_RPORT.get_Tranches(p.id,:sysdat) *t.ostat as kred_meb_ek,
case when CM_RPORT.get_Tranches(p.id,:sysdat)<>0 then p.annualyinterestrate||' %' else '0' end as gunver_faiz,
h.rest, h.rest*t.ostat as guns_qaliqek,p.purposeofcredit,trunc(months_between(p.duedatefirstcontract,p.dateofconclusion))as month 
from 
 smart.cm_portfolio p,filial f,cm_boorowerinfo b,cm_loanaccounts l,avalute v,smart.temprate t,cm_history h
 where p.branchid=f.id and 
 b.creditid=p.id   and p.usrgroup not in(84,85) and
 l.creditid=p.id and  
 v.VALUTE=p.currency and
 t.val_kod =p.currency --and CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:sysdat)>0
 and h.creditid=p.id and 
 h.hdate=:sysdat and (CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:sysdat)+CM_RPORT.get_Tranches(p.id,:sysdat))>0





















order by CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:sysdat)

datasets.name: Rest
datasets.sql:
select sum(rest*k.ostat) as rest,sum( CM_RPORT.get_gununevqaliq((select max(dat) from smart.OPERKURS where dat<:dat),0,p.id))as AZN,
sum(CM_RPORT.get_gununevqaliq((select max(dat) from smart.OPERKURS where dat<:dat),1,p.id)*k.ostat)as USD,sum(CM_RPORT.get_gununevqaliq((select max(dat) from smart.OPERKURS where dat<:dat),45,p.id)*k.ostat)as EUR,
sum(CM_RPORT.get_Tranches(p.id,:dat ) *k.ostat)-sum(CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:dat )*k.ostat) as ferq,
(sum(rest*k.ostat) +(sum(CM_RPORT.get_Tranches(p.id,:dat ) *k.ostat)-sum(CM_RPORT.get_payment(p.id,:dat )*k.ostat))) as gununsonuna
 from cm_history h,cm_portfolio p,smart.OPERKURS k
where hdate=(select max(hdate) from cm_history where hdate<=(select max(dat) from smart.OPERKURS where dat<:dat)) and p.usrgroup not in(84,85)
and p.id=h.creditid and k.val_kod =p.currency and k.dat=(select max(dat) from smart.OPERKURS where dat<:dat)
